name: MS20XXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Korg MS-20-style semi-modular mono synth, circuit-modelled from the MS-20 schematics: the KLM-307 (MK2) and KORG35 (MK1) filter boards solved from their circuit equations, Hz/V sockets, the panel's voltage laws. Every MS-20 patch jack in its place, normalled like the hardware, patched by touch; an SQ-10-style sequencer; 63 patches with cables.
